name: @noryx/orchestrator-validator
description: Deterministic validator for the Git-native NOAH orchestration task-record schema (Markdown + strict YAML front matter + structured, append-only history) — Stage 1B. Validates schema shape, the canonical 14-state transition/decision-gate model, append-only history invariants, task-ID/artifact-SHA rules, and terminal-state freeze. No network access, no database; reads only Git-tracked file content.
